propositions: Extract build_model_settings() and build_usage_limits() from runner.py into structured_run.py as pure functions with explicit parameters; build_model_settings must not mutate the temperature-withdrawn set.
build_usage_limits must return a tuple of (UsageLimits, req_limit, eff_max_iter) because eff_max_iter is not recoverable from the UsageLimits object due to max() non-invertibility.
cache_settings must be passed as a parameter to build_model_settings, not recomputed internally, to preserve the model_override guard that keeps cache settings None on the offline TestModel path.
The extraction must preserve all comments (approximately 50% of the region) including the temperature-deprecation matrix and per-request-vs-config precedence rationale.
runner.py must drop from 699 to under 700 lines total, with structured_run.py remaining under 500 lines (measured headroom ~23 lines after this extraction).
The seam guard test must be updated to include build_model_settings and build_usage_limits in both the importability assertion and the symbol-removal verification to prevent silent passing.
